metadata.description: Personal plugin marketplace for spinlockdevelopment — Claude Code skills and slash commands for project lifecycle, developer environments, and deployment-target references.

plugins.name: spindev-core
plugins.description: Session / project-lifecycle primitives: /end-session, /init-project, /pr-prepass, /review-plan, plus the gh skill and the pr-prepass subagent. Includes a non-blocking gh-workflow PreToolUse hook for advisory checks on gh + git push.

plugins.name: spindev-devenv
plugins.description: Developer-machine setup: hardened-shell Docker sandbox and ubuntu-debloat bringup.

plugins.name: spindev-deploy
plugins.description: Deployment-platform + on-prem infrastructure reference skills: flyio (fly.io ops), sprites-dev (sprite CLI guardrails), forgejo (self-hosted git server in Docker for GitHub mirroring + on-prem-only repos), restic-backup (encrypted append-only NAS + write-only Cloudflare R2 chain). flyio and sprites-dev ship PreToolUse Bash hooks (fly-guard, sprite-guard).

plugins.name: spindev-docs
plugins.description: Repo-aware design doc generator: technical-writer subagent + skill scans the repo, emits a delta-aware mkdocs-material site (incremental updates on rerun, full regen on rebase / force-push), validates with mkdocs build --strict, and scaffolds an opt-in GitHub Pages workflow via /docs-deploy. Output is plain mkdocs — portable to Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, or any static host.
